## 🔖 To use the Qwen3-VL GGUF Quantized models you have to install *llama-cpp-python*


**🛑 STOP COMFYUI**

**📂 Activate the ComfyUI Virtual Enviroment**

In your ComfyUI root installation folder type:
on Windows:

Command Prompt:
```
\venv\Scripts\activate.bat
```
or Power Shell:
```
\venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1
```
on Linux:
```
. /venv/bin/activate
```
**⬇️ Install llama-cpp-python**
```
pip install --upgrade --force-reinstall --no-cache-dir "llama-cpp-python @ git+https://github.com/JamePeng/llama-cpp-python.git"
```
**🔄 Restart ComfyUI and enjoy**

# ⚠️ Token Settings for I2V Timeline Presets

## 📊 Important Token Recommendations

### 🎬 I2V Timeline (20s) - 4 Prompts
- **Required**: `max_tokens = 2048` or higher
- **Risk with 1536**: 4th prompt may be truncated or incomplete
- **Timeline affected**: (At 15s) to (At 20s) markers may be missing

### 🍿 I2V Timeline (5s) - Single Prompt  
- **Required**: `max_tokens = 1024` or higher
- **Risk with <1024**: Timeline descriptions may be truncated

## 🎯 Why This Matters

```
I2V Timeline Structure:
├── Prompt 1: (At 0s) ... (At 5s)  [~260-440 tokens]
├── Prompt 2: (At 5s) ... (At 10s) [~260-440 tokens]  
├── Prompt 3: (At 10s) ... (At 15s) [~260-440 tokens]
└── Prompt 4: (At 15s) ... (At 20s) [~260-440 tokens]
                                    ↑
                            Truncated with 1536 tokens!
```

## ✅ Recommended Settings

| Preset | max_tokens | Context Length | Temperature |
|--------|------------|----------------|-------------|
| I2V Timeline (20s) | **2048** | 16384+ | 0.7-0.8 |
| I2V Timeline (5s) | **1024** | 8192+ | 0.7-0.8 |

## 🔧 Implementation

Set these parameters in your QwenVL node:
- `max_tokens`: 2048 (for 20s timeline)
- `context_length`: 16384 or higher  
- `temperature`: 0.7-0.8 for creative output

**Result**: All 4 prompts complete with full timeline markers! 🎬✨

---

## 🤖 Model Recommendations

### 🎬 For I2V Timeline (20s) - 4 Prompts
**✅ STRONGLY RECOMMENDED: Qwen3-VL-8B**
- Better reasoning for complex 4-prompt sequences
- Superior character continuity across all prompts
- Maintains style consistency throughout timeline
- Handles complex timeline markers without degradation

### 🍿 For I2V Scene (5s) - Single Prompt  
**✅ SUFFICIENT: Qwen3-VL-4B**
- Works well for single prompt generation
- Lower VRAM requirements
- Good for simpler tasks

### ⚠️ Qwen3-VL-4B Issues with Timeline (20s):
- May lose coherence in 3rd/4th prompt
- Character continuity problems
- Style inconsistency between prompts
- Tendency to oversimplify final prompt

### 💡 VRAM vs Quality Trade-off:
| Model | VRAM Needed | Timeline (20s) | Scene (5s) |
|-------|-------------|----------------|------------|
| Qwen3-VL-4B | ~8-10GB | ⚠️ Risky | ✅ Good |
| Qwen3-VL-8B | ~12-16GB | ✅ Excellent | ✅ Excellent |

**🎯 Production Recommendation**: Use Qwen3-VL-8B for best timeline quality!
